scope: Frozen single-voice English research evaluation; not independent speaker/source population validation, calibrated confidence or production recording verdict
license: AASIST MIT; LJSpeech public domain; WaveFake CC BY-SA 4.0 with publisher attribution

sources: WaveFake Zenodo 5642694 official ZIP member range requests
protocol.selection: Hash-order first 48 matched streamed genuine utterances; choose 12 development and 12 held-out utterances, no shared utterance IDs. Pair development genuine with MelGAN, held-out genuine with WaveGlow. Selection frozen before AASIST scoring.
protocol.score: Raw class-0 spoof softmax, uncalibrated; class1 bona-fide logit also retained. Fixed diagnostic argmax boundary only, no deployment threshold.
protocol.recordingResearchPolicy: Duration-weighted mean of scored non-overlapping segment softmax, using unpadded duration. If no usable segments, retain explicit abstention; never a production recording verdict.
protocol.eer: Descriptive ROC equal-error crossing with linear interpolation on each scored sample; not a deployable held-out-derived operating threshold.
limitations: One public-domain English voice, shared speaker/book/original source recordings across roles; not speaker/source-independent population validation.
Utterance and sampled generator-disjoint roles do not prove absence from AASIST training or independence of synthesis architectures.
Matched MP3 is a paired robustness transformation, not an additional independent recording.
No voice-conversion, Hindi/Telugu, music, environmental-audio or reliable speech-activity validation.
